messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: elevated 5xx rate detected for hosted-api (us-west-2). threshold 10% breached at 03:12:25 UTC. paging oncall.
elaine: seeing 5xx jump to ~22% for /v1/chat and some 524 gateway timeouts. started ~03:12:20 UTC
sre-oncall-ken: I'm on. opening dashboards. errors look concentrated on edge cluster e-west-prod-frontends
infra-max: there was a config push 03:12:18 UTC from config-service: route change to '/v1/' adding retries: attempts=2, per_try_timeout=1500ms
support-lin: customers reporting truncated streams and reconnects; one enterprise tenant reported retry storms causing duplicate messages
elaine: logs show many repeated upstream reset errors and 429/503 alternating. looks like a retry loop into overloaded backend
sre-oncall-ken: initial hypothesis: new retry config + LB sticky routing caused reconnects to hotspots -> backend conn pool exhaustion -> 5xx cascade
deploy-bot: CONFIG-ROLL: config-service applied route-template v15 -> v16 to edge cluster e-west-prod-frontends at 03:12:18 UTC
infra-max: can we temporarily remove retries on that template? I can push a rollback of just that field
elaine: mitigation plan: 1) disable route retries 2) drop max_conns on envoy cluster to throttle, 3) scale backend pool if needed. prioritize (#1) now
ops-bot: Emergency change CHG-240315-997 issued and auto-approved per runbook for mitigation steps
infra-max: patching route-template: set retry_policy: none; pushing to 2 canaries first
sre-oncall-ken: while that's landing, set circuit_breaker max_connections from 2000 -> 800 to prevent single upstream overload
infra-max: applied to canary proxies. canaries showing error rate drop from 22% -> 5% within 45s
elaine: good signal. begin full rollout of retry disable
support-lin: updating support -> telling customers we see a config-induced regression and are rolling mitigations; short note: "we're rolling a fix, more updates in 20 mins"
infra-max: full rollout complete across e-west-prod-frontends at 03:13:40 UTC
sre-oncall-ken: global error rate now at ~4.7%, streaming truncations down. marking status: Contained. will monitor for 30m before resolve
elaine: note: some backends show high TIME_WAIT sockets, clearing old connections helped. applied LB connection timeout reduction 45s -> 25s
sre-oncall-ken: capturing envoy config-dump and admin stats for postmortem. saving to artifacts.

```
# sample command used
curl -sS http://edge-proxy-7.internal:9901/config_dump | jq '.configs[] | {static: .static_resources, dynamic: .dynamic_resources}' > /tmp/edge7-config.json
```

deploy-bot: Artifact saved: s3://redwood-incidents/2410012345/configs/edge7-config.json
ops-bot: Incident ticket INC-2410012345 created and linked to CHG-240315-997
infra-max: root cause blurb: route-level retry defaults were enabled in the template without accounting for streaming long-tail per-try-timeouts; retries retriggered clients and overloaded backends that already had uneven load due to sticky LB keys
elaine: customer impact draft: approx 9-14% of requests impacted for 16 minutes peak in us-west-2, primary symptom: 5xx and truncated streams for conversation workloads. no persisted data corruption. we have opened support tickets for affected high-tier customers.
sre-oncall-ken: follow-ups assigned: 1) revert risky defaults from route templates and add explicit opt-in (owner: infra-max), 2) add pre-deploy traffic simulation for streaming patterns in CI (owner: ajay), 3) update runbook to order: disable retries -> tune CB -> scale pool (owner: elaine), 4) implement canary health gate that checks streaming tail latencies (owner: platform-team)
infra-max: I'll open PR to add opt-in flag and add a config validation check that blocks retries with per_try_timeout < 2s for streaming routes
elaine: handing over to Ken for postmortem writeup and customer comms. taking off pager but will remain on-call for 1hr of watch
sre-oncall-ken: taking handoff. status: mitigations live, metrics stable. will publish timeline and RCA, and schedule postmortem in #incidents. :white_check_mark:
support-lin: I'll coordinate customer notifications and compile list of affected orgs from logs
ops-bot: Note: maintenance alerts suppressed for affected clusters until incident resolved
elaine: thanks all. good mitigation velocity. postmortem items look clear.
